name: Collectible Scatter
description: Placement and pickup of coins, rings, gems — the low-stakes economy that paces a level. It owns the spawn pattern, the magnet that pulls nearby pickups toward the player, and the respawn rules, because those three decisions define how a level rewards its routes. It deliberately does not own what a pickup is worth: economy.collectible_collected carries a value, and economy.currency is one possible sink for it. A score counter, a 1-up counter, and a shop wallet can all listen to the same event without this component knowing any of them exist. It also does not own the pickup fanfare — presentation.particle_system and presentation.audio_system already do feedback, and a collectible that renders its own celebration can't be restyled.

inputs.name: spawnPattern
inputs.description: How pickups are arranged: scatter fills a region, line traces a jump arc (use the arc to teach the intended trajectory), ring circles a hazard, grid fills evenly.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: How many pickups this scatter owns. Density is a difficulty dial: sparse lines guide, dense fields reward exploration.

inputs.name: collectibleValue
inputs.description: Value attached to each economy.collectible_collected event. The component does not spend or bank it — that is the listener's economy.

inputs.name: magnetRadius
inputs.description: Distance within which pickups drift toward the player. Zero requires touching each one, which suits precision challenges; a generous radius suits speed runs.

inputs.name: magnetSpeed
inputs.description: How fast an attracted pickup travels. Slower than player top speed lets a runner outrun their own pickups, which reads as broken; keep it comfortably faster.

inputs.name: collectRadius
inputs.description: Contact distance that counts as a pickup once magnetism brings one close, or directly when magnetRadius is zero.

inputs.name: respawnSeconds
inputs.description: Seconds before a collected pickup returns. Zero means never — the default, because respawning currency invites farming loops the designer didn't intend.

outputs.name: isCleared
outputs.description: True when every pickup is collected and none will respawn. The 100%-run signal.
